I let my guard down, mooo!

rows.label: tlk70000058_02_msg0002

around with my weapon put away, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000058_02_msg0003

and easier to get badly hurt, mo.
I'd completely forgotten, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000058_02_msg0004

You never know when or where enemies
might attack, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000058_02_msg0005

Because of that, I couldn't make it to
my partner again, mooo. It's really
getting me down, mo...
